entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: The land of respondent no.1 bearing Gat/Survey No.213/4 admeasuring 0.57 HR out of 02.02 HR situated at village Wadhona Bajar, Taluka Ralegaon, District Yavatmal, was acquired for construction of main canal of Bembla project.
Notification under Section 4 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, was published on 23-08-2007 and award was passed on 26-08-2010.
It was the case of respondent no.1/claimant that the compensation awarded by the respondent/Special Land Acquisition Officer was not just, proper and reasonable.
In the reference filed by respondent no.1 the enhancement of compensation as stated above of Rs.7,15,590/- per Hector was granted.

4. Learned Counsel for respondent no.1 submits that the controversy involved in the instant appeal is covered by judgment dated 05-10-2023 passed by this Court in First Appeal No.965/2022 and judgment dated 05-10-2023 in First Appeal No.645/2019.
He submits that the land in question is seasonally irrigated land and the said judgments are also with respect to seasonally irrigated lands.
He therefore submits that the instant appeal may be decided for the reasons mentioned in the said judgments.
Pertinent to note, after considering all the relevant factors, the appeals filed by the appellant are dismissed upholding the enhanced compensation.

3 fa 534.21 jud.odt 5. Learned Counsel for the respondents does not dispute the fact that the controversy involved in the instant appeal is covered by the judgment passed in Land Acquisition Case Nos.965/2022 and 645/2019.
6.
In view of this, there is no reason to take a different view.
As such there is no substance in the instant appeal.
Appeal is accordingly dismissed.
7. Respondent no.1 is allowed to withdraw the amount of compensation with accrued interest and other benefits deposited in this Court.
No order as to costs.
(Prafulla S. Khubalkar, J.) Deshmukh Signed by: Mr. S.Deshmukh Designation: PS To Honourable Judge Date: 06/01/2026 18:14:02
